files.full_profiles.csv: 60 quality-profile people, descriptive FULL history only; never use these labels for heldout-building selection
files.fold_profiles.csv: 1320 rows = 22 heldout buildings x 60 people; unique key heldout_building,worker_id
files.nested_fold_features.csv: 27720 rows = 22 x 21 ordered outer/inner excluded buildings x 60 people; for reverse-route model training, both target and sample building excluded

identities.worker_id: frozen anonymized W ID; inventory has 62, quality population 60, Q-supported 59
identities.heldout_building: excluded validation building; test answers never fit Q, time, labels or selection
identities.outer_heldout_building: outer validation building in nested file
identities.inner_heldout_building: building containing a training sample; additionally excluded when learning its personnel features

quality.Q_effect_B8L2: task-adjusted global worker beta in score points, equal-worker zero anchor; use only when Q_supported
quality.Q_effect_D10: same model and records, direction scale 10 sensitivity
quality.theta_easy_B8L2: three-difficulty partial-pooling lambda20 historical effect for easy
quality.hard_minus_easy_B8L2: theta_hard minus theta_easy, historical self-contrast, not absolute hard quality
quality.hard_minus_medium_B8L2: theta_hard minus theta_medium; not combined with easy
quality.absolute_B8L2_mean: ordinary Manual historical score mean; tasks unadjusted, not a prospective test score
quality.percentile_B8L2: mean same-task percentile, average ties; depends on historical peer pool
quality.difficulty_supported_easy,difficulty_sup: each needs >=6 unique tasks and >=3 buildings; thin finite theta estimates stay visible without becoming specialty evidence

time.T_source_effect: main pooled same source-task adjusted log(seconds) effect; negative faster; old/new provenance remains confounded with cohort
time.T_source_origin_effect: same model fitted separately within each origin/source-kind, independently centered; sensitivity, NOT calibration between sources
time.T_source_supported: >=6 distinct source tasks and >=3 buildings; false must not be treated as slow or zero
time.T_target_effect: actual target-matched log-time model only; never substitute T_source_effect
time.T_target_supported: same coverage gate for target-only time; most workers not supported
time.T_source_origin,T_source_kinds: audited v1 inherited vs new processed reported provenance for sensitivity restrictions

classes.Q2_B8L2: Q+ if beta>=0, Q- otherwise, unknown if unsupported
classes.Q3_B8L2: above_peer beta>=3; below_peer beta<=-3; near_peer otherwise
classes.QT_B8L2: Q2 x T_relative_2; unknown if either axis unsupported
classes.difficulty_type_B8L2: requires all three difficulty support gates; across_strong, hard_specialist, hard_relative_lift_only, hard_drop, mixed_or_near, or unknown; exact definitions REGISTRATION.json
classes.fine_dtype_B8L2: unmerged QT x difficulty_type; retain sparse real members, but exclude any string containing unknown from semantic type predictions or composition
classes.fine_dtype_merged_B8L2: split QT only with >=2 supported children each >=3 members; not_split means known child coverage but insufficient multi-child membership to split, NOT unknown. sparse_child means other known rare children. difficulty_unknown explicitly denotes missing support.

strategy_interface_amendment.reason: Keep Q vs difficulty selection on the same historical personnel pool, while separately identifying thin target-difficulty estimates. This amendment was agreed before reading new fusion outcomes and does not alter classes or thresholds.
strategy_interface_amendment.QD_allhistory: Q_supported and finite theta at target difficulty; same candidate pool as Q, partial-pooled estimates allowed even if specific difficulty_supported=false; report selected thin-support count, never call them proven specialists
strategy_interface_amendment.QD_supported: target difficulty_supported subset; compare Q and QD on exactly that same subset
strategy_interface_amendment.QT_and_QTD: source-T known candidate pool only; <=3 score-point shortlist margin as predeclared; insufficient known T gives not_available, no zero fill
strategy_interface_amendment.fine_composition: intersection of Q_supported, T_source_supported, all three difficulty support gates; compare Q2, QT and fine_dtype on same workers to separate type detail from eligibility changes

validation_target: primary peer-relative Q among exactly matched same-task evaluation workers; absolute prediction separately uses training-only difficulty intercept. No test Q used for profiles or selection.
